title: Patch: art-first cards in play
notes: Full-art looks and Legendary/Mythic cards drop names and text on the board to prioritize art; keyword marks and boardNames setting added.

player.title: Art-first cards in play
changes: Cards in play wearing full-art looks and every Legendary and Mythic card drop their name and text to let art stand edge-to-edge, showing their name on hover or a long press.
Card settings add Names on the board to choose between Art first, Always, or Never.
